review_state.title: The Cleaner Growth System Most Busy Teams Are Missing
review_state.description: Most busy teams are losing time and momentum to broken growth systems. Here's the practical fix founders and executives actually need.
review_state.preview_text: When a yellow heat warning hits Ireland, people don't ignore it. They adjust. They change how they move, what they prioritise, and what they stop doing entirely. That's a sensible system response to a clear signal.
